rate_limits: 150 requests per 10 seconds; exceeding it returns HTTP 429 and triggers a 60-second timeout.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct. Official REST API docs state the API is rate-limited to 150 requests every 10 seconds; exceeding yields HTTP 429 and a 60-second timeout (https://platform.stability.ai/docs/api-reference). Same text appears on the platform FAQ (https://platform.stability.ai/faq). Original "not published" is wrong.
